notes: Account background: mid-market product analytics SaaS (in-app guides + user education).
Primary contact: Priya Nair (VP Product). Technical lead: Daniel Ortiz (Lead Platform Eng).
Initial interest: move from a lightweight rule-based onboarding to a guided copilot that can handle multi-step flows and tool calls (lookups, segment writes).
Key ask from PD: streaming responses + tool calling (invoke internal SaaS APIs) with predictable latency for user-facing flows.
Cost sensitivity: product team wants hard token caps per session to control costs (caps on prompt + generation tokens), plus cost forecast for 100k monthly active new users.
Preference: start on Redwood Hosted API to validate UX; if cost/latency profiles justify, migrate to Redwood Dedicated for steady-state throughput and predictable SLAs.
Latency SLO discussed: target 300ms P95 for initial short-turn messages (first streaming chunk) and <= 500ms P95 for full-turn completion in typical 150-token answers.
Throughput target for POC: 50 concurrent sessions with average 2 requests/min per session (bursting up to 200 req/s for marketing campaigns).
Security: SSO/SAML is mandatory; audit logs and KMS for key management; legal insists on US data residency for first-year deployment.
Model preferences: open models + Redwood-verified variants; want fallback routing to a cheaper quantized variant during non-critical hours.
Engineering constraints: client SDKs are React Native + backend in Go; wants server-side streaming support and robust reconnect semantics.
Quote from Priya on demo call: "We need the copilot to feel instant — anything that feels laggy will tank onboarding completion."
Quote from Daniel: "Show me realtime metrics for token spend per route and a way to enforce caps programmatically."
POC scope agreed: two-week Hosted API POC (prod-sim traffic), test streaming + tool calling with 3 sample flows (signup guide, plan upgrade, feature discovery).

POC success metrics: <300ms P95 for first-chunk streaming, <2s median end-to-end for 150-token completions, <=10% failure rate for tool calls, token spend under forecasted budget for baseline traffic.
Pricing discussion notes: interested in a blended hosted -> dedicated migration pathway; willing to commit to Dedicated 3-6 gpu reserved if economics show 40-60% cost reduction vs hosted at scale.
